# Project 1: OttoNinja Swarm Robot

You already have the base chassis, NiceNano, 4 servos, and ultrasonic sensor for Unit 01. Below are the procurement tables for **upgrading your current OttoNinja** with full vision/radio, and for **replicating complete new swarm units**.

## Option 1A: Upgrade Current OttoNinja Head (Vision, LoRa Radio & Speech)
Adds the autonomous head brain, 2.4 GHz LoRa swarm transceiver, and I2S speaker to your existing walking chassis.

| Component | Specification / Model | Purpose | Where to Buy (Cheapest Direct Link) | Unit Price | Qty | Subtotal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Head MCU & Camera** | Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense (8MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, OV2640 Cam + PDM Mic) | Vision capture, on-device `llama2.c` persona, speech input | [Seeed Studio Store](https://www.seeedstudio.com/Seeed-Studio-XIAO-ESP32S3-Sense-p-5639.html) / [AliExpress](https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-Seeed-Studio-XIAO-ESP32S3-Sense.html) | $13.99 | 1 | $13.99 |
| **Swarm Radio** | Ebyte E28-2G4M12S (Semtech SX1280 2.4GHz LoRa SPI Module) | High-speed swarm mesh, telemetry & snapshot reception | [AliExpress Search](https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-E28-SX1280-2.4GHz-LoRa-module.html) | $6.50 | 1 | $6.50 |
| **Audio Amplifier** | MAX98357A I2S 3.2W Class-D Mono Amp Breakout | Synthesizes loud, clear officer interrogation speech | [AliExpress Search](https://www.aliexpress.com/wholesale?search_query=MAX98357A+I2S+amplifier+module) | $1.20 | 1 | $1.20 |
| **Micro Speaker** | 20mm 8Ω 1W Cavity Micro Speaker (with wires) | Mounts into bottom acoustic grille of head tray | [AliExpress Search](https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-20mm-8-ohm-1w-mini-speaker.html) | $0.80 | 1 | $0.80 |

# Project 2: AR Display Glasses ("Research-Visor")

You already own the **BasedHardware OpenGlass** hardware (Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense + camera + mic + 250mAh LiPo + frame clip) and **Raspberry Pis**.

Below are the 3 hardware paths to turn your OpenGlass into an augmented reality system:

---

## Option 2A (Recommended): High-Resolution 0.39" Micro-OLED Optical Prism HUD
*Plugs into the Raspberry Pi's HDMI port. Projects a crystal-clear, daylight-readable (1000+ nits) virtual screen floating 2.5 meters in front of your eye.*

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
